Where the Colorado season stands

Four windows. The draw decides the first two, the market decides the third, and the phone rings through all four.

  1. 01 Feb – Apr

    Apply

    The application window and the point you buy. Residency and preference points decide nearly all of it.

    Colorado units →
  2. 02 Apr – Jun

    Results

    Results post. In the trophy units a nonresident is looking at odds under 1%, so most applicants are not hunting them this year.

    Struck out? →
  3. 03 Jun – Oct

    Vouchers

    LPP vouchers are listed, verified and moved. Peak supply, peak price, and the point where a struck-out hunter becomes a voucher buyer.

    This week's ledger →
  4. 04 Sep – Nov

    Hunt

    Seasons run. Unclaimed vouchers still move in the final weeks, and the ones that do not sell come back to the ledger next season.

    Today · 06 Nov 2026

Windows are typical across the four states; CPW's calendar governs, and every unit page carries the exact season dates with the source beside them. CPW's 2026 dates are not transcribed on this page yet — tracked as F4.
